description: Three records are read and displayed, then the fourth READ reports '23'. The interaction this case exists for is that the error arm must not retract what the loop already emitted: the three 150-character lines stand, in ascending key order, and the error triple follows them. That the abend happens inside 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT and not at the top of the mainline is what makes the ordering observable - app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:110-113 runs after :78 has already written three lines. Six lines out, and no end banner, because PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM at :113 never returns to :83 or :85. RETURN-CODE is 12 from :101.
